close_reason: Folded into JMAP-g7wu.1 mega-PR per [2026-05-11 bundling decision]. extract_account_id signature changed from (args: &Value) -> Result<Id, JmapError> to (args: Value) -> Result<(Id, Map<String, Value>), JmapError>. Improved error message: 'arguments must be an object containing accountId' instead of the misleading 'accountId is required' for non-object payloads. Every handler call site across 8 server crates now uses 'let (account_id, mut args) = extract_account_id(args)?;' eliminating the redundant Value::Object pattern-match. ~80 call sites migrated.
notes:
Investigated: minimal fix (make extract_account_id reject non-objects) does not eliminate the second pattern-match in handlers because handlers still need the Map<String,Value> for further field access. The clean fix requires changing extract_account_id signature to consume Value and return (Id, Map<String,Value>), which is an API break on the canonical jmap-server foundation crate and propagates across ~30 handler call sites in 7 extension-server crates. Per cookie-cutter rule this is one large coordinated change.

Active work item — should land alongside the other API-break-class beads (JMAP-g7wu.1 CallerCtx forwarding, JMAP-g7wu.3 helpers builder refactor) so the coordinated cross-crate breakage happens once.
[2026-05-10 do-beads triage] This bead's 'clean fix' is a SemVer break on jmap-server foundation that ripples across 7 extension crates (~30 handler call sites). Per jmap-server AGENTS.md: 'Prefer non-breaking changes. Reshape only when the workspace is bumping a major.'

Decision needed from human:

1. Do the minimal fix now (clarify error message in extract_account_id; second pattern-match stays because handlers need Map<String,Value>)? Improves error clarity for non-object payloads; no SemVer break; bead remains partly open for the pattern-match cleanup until a future 0.2.0.

2. Land the clean fix as part of a coordinated 0.2.0 push alongside JMAP-g7wu.1 (CallerCtx forwarding through *Backend traits)? JMAP-g7wu.1 is currently labeled 'human' with 5 design questions outstanding, so this gates on those.

3. Land the clean fix independently as a 0.2.0 push now? Requires committing to a major bump without the CallerCtx work being ready.

Recommendation: option 2. The clean fix and JMAP-g7wu.1 are both extension-server SemVer breaks; bundling them halves the downstream pain. But the CallerCtx design questions need answering first.

This bead is now labeled 'human' to keep the do-beads loop from spinning on it.
Bundled into JMAP-g7wu.1 mega-PR per [2026-05-11 bundling decision] comment; opencode session 2026-05-11 picking up implementation
